The Shandur Polo Festival is an extraordinary celebration
that takes place over three days at Shandur Pass. The
Shandur Festival brings together the Gilgit and Chitral
tribes who reside in the northern regions of Pakistan. The
two tribes hail from the Gilgit-Baltistan and Chitral
regions, and they meet at the Shandur pass every
summer for the polo festival.
The Shandur Pass is home to a gorgeous polo ground
where unique free-style polo matches are played,
between Chitral and Gilgit Baltistan teams. One of the
distinctive aspects of the Shandur Polo Festival is the
ground itself.
The Shandur Polo Ground is at an altitude of 3,700
meters above sea level, making it the highest polo field
above sea level in the world. The incredible polo ground
is situated next to the beautiful Shandur Lake,
